children: Braze reported fiscal second-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $227.2 million, up 26.2% year-over-year, and record second-quarter cash from operations of $24.2 million. GAAP operating loss narrowed to $18.1 million while non-GAAP operating income was $22.0 million; non-GAAP diluted net income per share was $0.19. The company also generated free cash flow of $21.7 million and provided guidance for Q3 and the full fiscal year 2027 on a non-GAAP basis.
Revenue: $227.2 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, up 26.2% year-over-year (Q2 2025: $180.1 million).
Gross profit: $151.9 million; GAAP gross margin 66.8% and non-GAAP gross margin 68.6% for the quarter.
Operating results: GAAP operating loss of $18.1 million; non-GAAP operating income of $22.0 million for the quarter.
Net income / EPS: GAAP net loss per share attributable to common stockholders, basic and diluted, of $(0.17); non-GAAP net income per diluted share of $0.19.

Cash flow and liquidity: Net cash provided by operating activities of $24.2 million and non-GAAP free cash flow of $21.7 million for the quarter; total cash, restricted cash, and marketable securities of $413.9 million as of July 31, 2026.

Customer growth and retention: Total customers increased to 2,789 (from 2,422 a year earlier); dollar-based net retention was 110% for trailing 12 months, with 112% retention for customers with ARR ≥ $500,000.
Enterprise traction: Number of customers with ARR of $500,000 or more rose to 361 from 282 year-over-year, reflecting upsells and renewals.

Product and AI adoption: Accelerating adoption of AI offerings including BrazeAI Operator, BrazeAI Agent Console, and BrazeAI Decisioning Studio; Operator expanded to create Canvas steps from conversational prompts and pre-built Agents for faster deployment.

Partnerships and integrations: Entered a 3-year Strategic Collaboration Agreement with AWS (including a dedicated co-sell motion), expanded Databricks CustomerLake bi-directional integration, and earned Snowflake APJ Product Growth Partner of the Year recognition.

Market and community engagement: Announced Braze Forge 2026 conference (Sept. 28–30, Las Vegas), published the fifth annual ESG report, welcomed startups to the Tech for an Equitable Future grant program, and secured multiple workplace recognitions internationally.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Braze posts 26% y/y revenue growth to $227.2M, GAAP loss narrows; non-GAAP EPS $0.19
